title: Anne Arundel County – Sheriff – Appointment of Majors
material_provisions: Authorizes (not requires) Sheriff of Anne Arundel County to appoint three majors
Majors serve at the pleasure of the Sheriff
Salary determined by County Council of Anne Arundel County
Applies only to Anne Arundel County

adopted_amendments.significance: Changes bill from mandatory to permissive

required_facts: Majors serve at pleasure of Sheriff

critical_distinctions.shall_vs_may: Bill uses 'may' - permissive authorization, not mandate. This is THE key change.
critical_distinctions.jurisdiction: Anne Arundel County only, not statewide. Explicitly limited.
critical_distinctions.specific_count: Exactly three majors, not more or less or unlimited

statutes_amended: Article – Courts and Judicial Proceedings, Section 2–315(c)
